evals.prompt: I have a Herdr agent named 'reviewer' already running. Ask it to summarize the open PRs and show me what it says back.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the reviewer target via herdr agent get/list, sends with pane run (or agent send + enter), waits on agent-status (working then done/idle) rather than a blind sleep, reads recent-unwrapped, and relays the reply.

evals.prompt: Spin up two Herdr agents for this project named 'tests' and 'docs'. Use pi with thinking low for both. Put them in the same project workspace so I can see both panes at once.
evals.expected_output: Checks herdr status, reuses or creates one workspace for the project, creates one fleet tab and split panes (not one tab per agent) with --no-focus, launches pi --thinking low in each, renames agents, waits until idle/ready. No server stop.

evals.prompt: I'm done with all my Herdr fleet agents for this project — shut them down.
evals.expected_output: Treats teardown as destructive: confirms first, prefers closing the skill-created tabs/panes (or workspace if user wants) over herdr server stop unless explicitly requested, warns about lost state.

evals.prompt: Launch three Herdr agents (reviewer, tests, docs) for this repo with different tasks in parallel and keep them visible in one view so I can jump into any pane to steer.
evals.expected_output: One workspace, one fleet tab with three split panes, parallel-friendly spawn (no-focus), submits distinct tasks, explains human can herdr tab focus the fleet or herdr agent focus a pane to steer, does not nest tmux.

evals.prompt: Broadcast 'pull latest main and report status' to all my Herdr fleet agents and collect replies.
evals.expected_output: Uses broadcast.sh or equivalent send-all-then-wait-concurrent pattern, reports per-agent idle/timeout/blocked, does not serialize full send-wait-read per agent.

evals.prompt: My SSH session died — can you reattach my tmux coding agents?
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger herdr-agent-comms as the primary skill (tmux domain). Negative trigger: redirect to tmux-agent-comms or plain tmux help.
